$comment: Upstream files used to build and cross-check scattering tables. Files are fetched into data-sources/cache/ (git-ignored) and rejected unless their SHA-256 matches. Role 'primary' feeds a generated table; 'crosscheck' is only compared against it. URLs pin a commit where the host allows it. Retrieved 2026-10-02.

sources.description: DABAX f0_WaasKirf.dat: reformat (2013, f0_WaasKirf.tcl) of the authors' sfac.dat distributed with Waasmaier & Kirfel (1995).
sources.license: DABAX library (ESRF); no license statement in file. Redistribution assessment pending.

sources.description: cctbx wk1995.cpp: independent reformat of the same authors' sfac.dat (picked up 1995-07-04, verified 2001-09-12).
sources.license: cctbx BSD-style license; used for comparison only, not redistributed.

sources.description: DABAX f0_InterTables.dat: ITC Vol. C (1992) Table 6.1.1.4 four-Gaussian coefficients. Source of MATERIA's table (via xrayutilities).
sources.license: DABAX library (ESRF); comparison only.

sources.description: cctbx it1992.cpp: transcription of ITC Vol. C (1992) Table 6.1.1.4, pp. 500-502.
sources.license: cctbx BSD-style license; comparison only.

sources.description: gemmi it92.hpp: ITC Vol. C (1992 or later) four-Gaussian coefficients.
sources.license: MPL-2.0; comparison only.

sources.description: GSAS-II atmdata.py: XrayFF (Cromer & Waber, Int. Tables Vol. IV) and AtmBlens (Rauch & Waschkowski 2003 plus newer measurements; NOT Sears 1992).
sources.license: GSAS-II license; comparison only.

sources.description: NCNR/NIST hosted table, manually entered from Sears, Neutron News 3(3) 29-37 (1992). NIST notes possible entry errors. The page carries per-request Cloudflare tokens, so the pinned hash covers the extracted data table (one row per line, tab-separated cells), which is committed under data-sources/snapshots/ because the URL cannot be pinned to a revision.
sources.license: US Government work (NIST); underlying data from Sears (1992). Redistribution assessment pending.

sources.description: Mantid NeutronAtom.cpp: separate transcription of the Sears (1992) table, isotopes included.
sources.license: GPL-3.0+; comparison only, never redistributed.

sources.description: gemmi neutron92.hpp: natural-element coherent b from the NIST page (same lineage as cctbx).
sources.license: MPL-2.0; comparison only.

sources.description: Dans_Diffraction neutron_isotope_scattering_lengths_sears.dat: Sears, ITC Vol. C section 4.4.4. Source of MATERIA's neutron table.
sources.license: Apache-2.0; comparison only.

sources.description: periodictable nsf.py: Rauch (2003) ATI table plus newer measurements. A different evaluation, used to flag rows where newer data differ.
sources.license: Public domain; comparison only.

sources.description: Mantid unit-test UB file TOPAZ_3007.mat (ISAW layout), external test data addressed by MD5 (Testing/Data/UnitTest/TOPAZ_3007.mat.md5 @ 67c2f43). Used to test UB, goniometer and Laue conventions against real TOPAZ peaks.
sources.license: Mantid external test data; no license stated. Fetched for tests only, never committed or redistributed.
